topic: sub:12|Relative frequency and probability|Complement of an event

solutions.latex:
The total number of comments is the sum of the four members' comments.
$$\begin{aligned} \text{Total} &= 1.29 + 2.45 + 1.46 + 2.80 \\ &= 8 \text{ million} \end{aligned}$$
The comments not for Amelia are the total minus Amelia's $2.80$ million.
$$\begin{aligned} P(\text{not Amelia}) &= \dfrac{8 - 2.80}{8} \\ &= \dfrac{5.2}{8} \\ &= 0.65 \end{aligned}$$
Hence the correct option is C.

meta.format_note: Amelia's column assumed to be the $2.80$ million entry from the table; not checked against the table image.

6265.stem:
The probability of a lemon tree bearing fruit in its' first season is $20\%$. Nigella plants two lemon trees.

\exfigure{496_q27_1}

figures.cap: partly completed probability tree for two lemon trees

parts.latex: Complete the probability tree diagram above to show the possible outcomes (fruit or no fruit) for the two trees.
Find the probability that neither of the trees bear fruit.
Calculate the probability that at least one of the trees will bear fruit.

meta.format_note: Rubric written by us (source had none).

solutions.latex:
Both trees fail to bear fruit, with $P(\text{no fruit}) = 0.8$ each.
$$\begin{aligned} P(NN) &= 0.8 \times 0.8 \\ &= 0.64 \end{aligned}$$

meta.format_note: Rubric written by us (source had none).

solutions.latex:
At least one is the complement of neither.
$$\begin{aligned} P(\text{at least one}) &= 1 - P(\text{neither}) \\ &= 1 - 0.64 \\ &= 0.36 \end{aligned}$$

meta.format_note: Rubric written by us (source had none).

6290.stem: Ryan is playing with a well-shuffled standard deck of 52 cards.

parts.latex: What is the probability of drawing either a 4 or a black card?
What is the probability of not drawing an ace card?

solutions.latex:
There are $26$ black cards, plus the $2$ red 4's.

$$\begin{aligned} P(E) &= \dfrac{28}{52} \\ &= \dfrac{7}{13} \end{aligned}$$
